## Quick Summary
Javohir Sadullayev is a backend software engineer specializing in high-concurrency systems, event-driven architectures, and AI product integration using C# and .NET 8. He builds production-grade REST APIs, real-time WebSocket applications with SignalR, high-speed PostgreSQL and Redis data layers, and speech assessment models powered by Azure Cognitive Services.

## Key Projects
1. **EnglishAI**: Adaptive English learning platform with real-time speech assessment and pronunciation scoring. Built with ASP.NET Core, Azure Speech, Redis, and SignalR. Served 700+ active learners with <120ms speech latency and +78% onboarding completion.
2. **KitobdagiMen** (kitobdagimen.uz): Social book reading platform with Telegram Mini App auth, algorithmic discovery feed, and live quotes. Feed latency <45ms, 99.4% auth success rate.
3. **TypingWar**: Multiplayer real-time typing duel engine with sub-50ms synchronization, anti-cheat validation, and live matchmaking using SignalR and Redis Pub/Sub.
4. **ZiyoAI**: AI-driven educational platform with automated homework grading, multi-turn student tutoring, and OCR visual comprehension.
5. **MeningVaqtim**: High-performance productivity and focus tracker with habit analytics and offline synchronization.
